|game_text=Deploy on table if [Virtual Block 4] [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step]] on table. X = number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians. |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-78-Corellian_Engineering_Corporation.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-corellianengineeringcorporation-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB4-78-Corellian_Engineering_Corporation-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table if [Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step on table. X = number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians. While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is +X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force (except from your card), may reduce loss by X. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 78. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022202751/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=22, page 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=22 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Corellian Engineering Corporation (V) (Errata)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 4 March 2014, effective immediately: “X = number of spaceport sites controlled by Corellians” became “X = number of your spaceport sites controlled by your Corellians” (“your” added twice): “Deploy on table if [Virtual Block 4] Watch Your Step on table. X = number of your spaceport sites controlled by your Corellians. While you control Corellia, your total battle destiny is +X, and once per turn, if you are about to lose Force (except from your card), may reduce loss by X. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="forum-p869160">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 4 March 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p869160 p869160] (read 9 November 2026)</ref> The post (“The following errata is issued by the CBT, and is effective immediately”) gives the full text; it writes the icons as “[V4]” and “[A]”, which is notation only.
